Part I

Discover & enroll

How a visitor goes from the front door to a purchased seat.

01Discover

The front door

A brand-forward landing built to convert. The hero speaks the academy's language — one setup, 1:3 risk–reward, the SMP_TS story — over live platform stats pulled straight from the database.

  • Live counts: learners, enrollments, certificates
  • Browse-by-category and featured courses
  • Trust bar + an AI tutor reachable on every page
02Discover

Find the right course

A real catalog, not a grid of placeholders. Search the whole library and narrow by category, level, and price, then sort by popularity, rating, or price.

  • Full-text search across titles & descriptions
  • Category / level / price filters + 5 sort modes
  • Wishlist straight from the card
03Discover

Everything before you enroll

The decision page. Outcomes, a full curriculum with free previews, the instructor, and a ratings breakdown — with a sticky enrollment card that knows whether you already own the course.

  • Expandable curriculum with preview lessons
  • Ratings histogram & verified reviews
  • Sticky enroll / buy / add-to-cart card
Part II

The learning experience

Everything a student touches after enrolling — classroom, dashboard, achievements and proof of skill.

04Learn

The classroom

A distraction-free player. Video and article lessons on the left, a progress-tracked curriculum on the right, and tabs for notes, Q&A and announcements underneath.

  • Resume where you left off, auto-advance
  • Timestamped note-taking per lesson
  • Auto-graded quiz engine with instant feedback
05Learn

Your learning HQ

Every student gets a home base: courses in progress, lifetime stats, current streak, upcoming live sessions and quick links to certificates.

  • Continue-learning with live progress bars
  • Enrolled / completed / points / streak tiles
  • Upcoming live sessions at a glance
06Learn

Motivation, gamified

A full gamification layer keeps learners coming back — points for every action, league tiers, unlockable badges, streaks, and a platform leaderboard.

  • Points ledger & league tiers (Bronze → Diamond)
  • Earned vs. locked badge gallery
  • Daily streaks + top-learner leaderboard
07Learn

Proof of skill

Certificates are auto-issued on completion — printable, shareable, and independently verifiable. Anyone can confirm a serial on the public verification page.

  • Auto-issued, printable / save-as-PDF
  • Unique serials, public lookup
  • Tamper-evident verification record
Part III

Tools for instructors

Analytics and a real course builder for the people who teach.

08Teach

For educators

Instructor Studio turns raw activity into insight: enrollment trends, revenue by course, top performers and recent reviews — the numbers a coach actually wants.

  • Enrollment & revenue analytics (Recharts)
  • Students, ratings and earnings views
  • Payout-ready earnings breakdown
09Teach

Build a course

A working course builder — not a mockup. Create a course, structure it into sections and lessons, set previews, and flip it live with one publish toggle.

  • Add / remove sections & lessons inline
  • Video, article and quiz lesson types
  • Draft ↔ Published with a live preview link
Part IV

Operate the whole platform

Admin oversight, community and live mentorship.

10Operate

Run the platform

An admin console for the whole business: signups and revenue over time, catalog by category, and searchable tables for users, courses and orders.

  • Platform KPIs + signup / revenue charts
  • User management with role filters
  • Course & order oversight
11Community

Learn together

A per-course Q&A forum where students ask and instructors answer. Threads can be pinned or marked resolved, and instructor replies are badged as official answers.

  • Course-scoped discussion threads
  • Instructor-answer & resolved states
  • Ask, reply, and earn community points
12Community

Live mentorship

Scheduled trade-alongs and webinars with one-click registration. Registrants get a reminder and a join link when the session goes live.

  • Upcoming & past sessions
  • One-click register / cancel
  • Host details, duration, attendee counts
Run it yourself

Clone, seed, and it's live in three commands.

The whole platform runs locally on SQLite with zero external services. Seed data includes the SMP_TS Bootcamp, instructors, students, quizzes, reviews and live sessions.

# 1 · install npm install # 2 · create + seed the database npm run setup # 3 · launch npm run dev → http://localhost:3000
